source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 2 (book p. 272); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Yahan do \(\cos^{-1}\) angles ka farq (difference) hai, aur jawab bhi \(\cos^{-1}\) mein hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\cos^{-1}\frac{7}{25}\) aur \(\cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\).
Find kya karna hai? Dikhana hai ke farq \(\cos^{-1}\frac{323}{325}\) hai.
Rule kaunsa? Cosine ke farq wala formula (iv); kisi badal ki zaroorat nahi kyunke sab pehle se \(\cos^{-1}\) hain.
Plan: do square roots nikalo, formula mein rakho, hisaab saaf karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos^{-1}\frac{7}{25}\) aur \(\cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\).
Maloom karna (prove): in ka farq \(\cos^{-1}\frac{323}{325}\) hai.
Tareeqa: dono terms pehle se \(\cos^{-1}\) hain, is liye seedha formula (iv) lagayenge: \(\cos^{-1}x - \cos^{-1}y = \cos^{-1}\left(xy + \sqrt{(1-x^{2})(1-y^{2})}\right)\), jahan \(x = \frac{7}{25}\), \(y = \frac{5}{13}\). Pehle shart check karenge, phir roots, phir formula.

Shart check karein
\[x = \tfrac{7}{25} = 0.28,\quad y = \tfrac{5}{13} \approx 0.385\]
Kyun: formula (iv) ko \(x \le y\) chahiye. \(\cos^{-1}\) ghatne wala (decreasing) function hai: chhota number, bara angle. Is liye \(\cos^{-1}0.28\) bara angle hai aur farq positive aayega, jaisa \(\cos^{-1}\) ki value ko hona chahiye (woh \([0, \pi]\) mein hoti hai).

Square roots nikalein
\[\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{49}{625}} = \tfrac{24}{25}\]
\[\sqrt{1-y^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{25}{169}} = \tfrac{12}{13}\]
Kyun: \(1 - \frac{49}{625} = \frac{576}{625}\) aur \(1 - \frac{25}{169} = \frac{144}{169}\), dono perfect squares hain. Yeh 7, 24, 25 aur 5, 12, 13 wale triples ki wajah se hai. Positive root isliye ke yeh asal mein un angles ke sines hain jo \([0, \pi]\) mein hain, jahan sine negative nahi hota.

Formula (iv) lagayein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \cos^{-1}\left(\tfrac{7}{25}\cdot\tfrac{5}{13} + \tfrac{24}{25}\cdot\tfrac{12}{13}\right)\]
\[= \cos^{-1}\left(\tfrac{35}{325} + \tfrac{288}{325}\right)\]
\[= \cos^{-1}\tfrac{323}{325} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: farq ke liye cosine formula mein plus aata hai (\(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\)). Denominator \(25 \times 13 = 325\); numerators \(7 \times 5 = 35\) aur \(24 \times 12 = 288\); jama 323.
Dhyan dein: yahan plus hai, Question 1 mein minus tha; sign ka faisla jama ya farq se hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos^{-1}0.28 - \cos^{-1}0.3846 \approx 1.2870 - 1.1760\]
\[= 0.1110\]
\[\cos^{-1}\tfrac{323}{325} \approx 0.1110\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: dono taraf ek hi chhota angle aaya (taqreeban \(6.4^{\circ}\)), is liye proof sahi hai.
